meta.title: Progress & Participation — ShrimpPulse roadmap and feedback
meta.description: The ShrimpPulse development timeline from the September 2026 proposal, reported user feedback on version 2.0, and how to participate or collaborate.

hero.title: Where the project has been, and where it is proposed to go
hero.lead: This page separates what has already happened from what is planned. The roadmap comes from the September 2026 proposal and remains subject to revision; proposed dates are targets, not promises.

timeline.title: Development timeline
timeline.sourceNote: Source: ShrimpPulse project proposal, September 2026. Milestones are not marked complete simply because their dates have passed; completed items are those documented in the proposal.

completed.title: Development of ShrimpPulse 2.0 began
completed.text: Flow-agent approach with knowledge-base retrieval; two modules on antibiotic and chemical usage.

completed.title: Field testing began
completed.text: Initial on-site testing of 2.0 with experienced shrimp farmers.

completed.title: Public release of ShrimpPulse 2.0
completed.text: Made available on LINE, free of charge.

completed.title: Development of ShrimpPulse 4.0 began
completed.text: Loop-agent architecture; first knowledge-base version with three modules.

completed.title: Structured user feedback system introduced
completed.text: Collecting feedback from 2.0 users to guide 4.0 priorities.

planned.title: Feedback analysis and benchmarking
planned.text: Analyse structured feedback and establish benchmarks for comparing versions.

planned.title: Integrated prototype and alpha testing
planned.text: Bring the three modules and the loop-agent workflow together for internal testing.

planned.title: Expert review and challenging-scenario testing
planned.text: Review of the knowledge base and skills, with testing on difficult cases.

planned.title: Closed beta and field pilot
planned.text: Limited release to selected users and farms.

planned.title: Refinement and validation
planned.text: Address pilot findings and validate before any wider release.

planned.title: Proposed public release of ShrimpPulse 4.0
planned.text: Subject to satisfactory validation and expert review.

planned.title: Post-launch evaluation
planned.text: Evaluate the release against the benchmarks set earlier.

planned.title: Framework for regular evidence updates
planned.text: Planned framework for updating the knowledge base as evidence changes.

feedback.title: What 2.0 users have reported
feedback.text: The September 2026 proposal reports 249 feedback responses from 256 active users as of 27 September 2026. These figures describe reported participation and feedback. They are not independently validated measures of accuracy, effectiveness, or impact, and users have not been converted into farms or market share.

requests.title: Disease and prevention information
requests.text: Now the third module in 4.0 development.

requests.title: Standard farm management
requests.text: A planned fourth module after the first three are established.

requests.title: Explanatory images
requests.text: Under consideration; feasibility and cost unresolved.

requests.title: Faster responses
requests.text: Informing the planned balance of speed, reasoning, and cost.

participate.title: Participation and collaboration
participate.text: ShrimpPulse grows through the people who use it and the specialists who review it. If you farm shrimp, work in aquaculture, conduct research, or represent an organisation interested in collaborating, the project would like to hear from you.
